# CyberScryb
> Free AI writers, life-document tools, and browser developer utilities

CyberScryb is a solo-built toolkit for freelancers, caregivers, and builders.
- Local browser tools (JSON, password, Base64, etc.) process data only on your device.
- AI writers (Humanizer, Gig Auto-Pilot, letters, detectors) send input to an AI backend for that one generation step; results are not stored as training data on our side.
- 100% Free with zero paywalls, zero accounts, and no subscriptions.

## Flagship AI tools

- [AI Humanizer](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/humanizer/): Rewrite stiff ChatGPT paste so it sounds human
- [Gig Auto-Pilot](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/gig-auto-pilot/): Job post → freelance proposal + draft
- [AI Writing Suite](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/ai-writing-suite/): Detect AI patterns and fix flagged sentences
- [Curator Prime](https://curator.cyberscryb.com): Photo → name, brand, value range, care notes
- [AI Text Summarizer](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/summarizer/)
- [AI Email Writer](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/email-writer/)
- [AI Paraphraser](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/paraphraser/)
- [AI Detector](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/ai-detector/)

## Developer utilities (local)

- [JSON ↔ CSV Converter](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/json-csv-converter/)
- [JSON Formatter](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/json-formatter/)
- [SEO Meta Generator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/seo-tag-generator/)
- [Password Strength Checker](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/password-checker/)
- [Is This Link Safe](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/is-this-link-safe/): Paste a link for a plain-language reading of lookalike domains and other red flags. The address stays in the browser.
- [Phishing Inbox Simulator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/phishing-inbox-simulator/): Mark fictional emails safe or phish and read the real link address. Answers stay in the browser.
- [Choose Your Own Hack](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/choose-your-own-hack/): A branching story where you are the target of a fictional scam. Choices and endings stay in the browser.
- [Tech Myth or Fact](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/tech-myth-or-fact/): Swipe Myth or Fact on tech claims and read a short explanation. Score and seen claims stay in the browser.
- [Password Habit Quiz](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/password-habit-quiz/): Twelve questions about password habits, a score, and a prioritized fix-it plan. No password is asked for. The last result stays in the browser.
- [Base64 Tool](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/base64-tool/)
- [Regex Tester](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/regex-tester/)
- [Cron Builder](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/cron-builder/)
- [Hash Generator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/hash-generator/)
- [JWT Decoder](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/jwt-decoder/)
- Full catalog: https://cyberscryb.com/tools/
